reason: Re-checked 2026-09-25 in headless Chromium: https://github.com/Hankintailmoitukset/hilma-api/blob/master/endpoints/avpendpoints.md says to subscribe at Products > avp-read and send Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key, but marks every operation reference (Search Notices eform-search, Index Definitions, Read EForms Notice/Notices, Read Plans) '(Sign in required)'. Rendered anonymously, the APIM portals show 'No APIs found' (https://hns-hilma-prod-apim.developer.azure-api.net/apis) and 'The specified API does not exist' (https://hns-hilma-test-apim.developer.azure-api.net/api-details#api=avp-read-api); the repo has no OpenAPI file. Search is an Azure Search query over an index whose fields are published only via the gated index-definition call, and full notices are Base64 eForms XML.
